workshoptitle: Build Connected Life Sciences Solutions with Oracle AI Database

tutorials.title: Introduction
tutorials.description: The Seer Scientific quality-alert and clinical-supply story, team, and workshop goals.

tutorials.title: Getting Started
tutorials.description: Launch the LiveLabs Sandbox reservation and open Database Actions SQL Worksheet as LLUSER.

tutorials.title: Lab 1: Build a Converged Dashboard Query
tutorials.description: Connect monitored posts, semantic product matching, JSON clinical supply orders, and spatial site context in Jessica's converged dashboard query.

tutorials.title: Lab 2: Build a Clinical Supply JSON Application Model
tutorials.description: Help Thomas create JSON settings and a document collection, then insert and update clinical supply practice orders through JSON Relational Duality and compare the relational results.

tutorials.title: Lab 3: Review a Sterility Concern Using Semantic Search
tutorials.description: Help Gilly create product vectors, compare keyword and semantic search, review related monitored posts, and join product matches to clinical supply order lines.

tutorials.title: Lab 4: Find Alternative Supply Depots Using Property Graphs
tutorials.description: Follow Bob's supply-order and inventory relationships with SQL/PGQ, then compare shared candidate depots in Graph Studio.

tutorials.title: Lab 5: Assess Trial-Site Coverage Using Spatial SQL
tutorials.description: Follow Moon from depot points and region distances to each trial site's nearest active cold-chain depot using Oracle Spatial SQL.

tutorials.title: Lab 6: Build a Supply Demand Watchlist with Oracle Machine Learning
tutorials.description: Train and score Otto's Life Sciences supply-demand watchlist with SQL, and optionally compare classification models with AutoML.

tutorials.title: Lab 7: Ask Life Sciences Questions with Select AI
tutorials.description: Use Select AI to turn Life Sciences questions into SQL Nina can inspect and run.

tutorials.title: Lab 8: Build a Life Sciences Agent with Select AI Agent
tutorials.description: Build Nina's native SQL question-answering agent and inspect its tool activity.

tutorials.title: Lab 9: Final Quiz
tutorials.description: Check your understanding of the eight Life Sciences technical labs and earn the workshop completion badge.

tutorials.title: Need Help?
tutorials.description: Solutions to common problems and directions for receiving Live Help.
